card.name: The word in before patient groups
card.fires_on: The word "in" right after an adverse effect or risk, when it introduces the group of patients affected (certain patients, neonates, pediatric patients). Seen in antidepressant and opioid warnings.

modes.label: Risk in a patient group
modes.description: "in" follows a named harm such as suicidality or suicidal behavior and leads into a population.
modes.example: . There has been a long-standing concern, however, that antidepressants may have a role in inducing worsening of depression and the emergence of suicidality<< in>> certain patients during the early phases of treatment

modes.label: Effects in neonates
modes.description: "in" follows effects of a drug and leads into the group exposed, such as newborns.
modes.example: and manage accordingly [see Warnings]. Labor or Delivery Opioids cross the placenta and may produce respiratory depression and psycho-physiologic effects<< in>> neonates. An opioid overdose reversal agent

card.writes: It prepares the model to name a particular group of people, such as "certain" patients.
card.plain: It marks the little word "in" that comes before the group of patients a warned-about effect applies to.
